title: EXP-098 - Hello World Part 6 Section 6: FX_OrdersChart Chart Component FX_OrderTotalChart (Binding Type Chart, FX_DerOrderTotal by FX_OrderNumber), Grid Moved Down and Hidden, One Designer Save, Runtime Chart Check
objective: Follow hello-world-pt6.md Section 5 step 7 and Section 6 (05:33-06:44), adapted to FX_ names and User scope, on the FX_OrdersChart Form created in EXP-097: move FormCollectionGrid toward the bottom through Layout > Location, place one Chart component from the Toolbox above it, rename it FX_OrderTotalChart and size it through Layout, set its Binding Type to Chart and in its Binding dialog add FX_DerOrderTotal to Chart Data with FX_OrderNumber as the X-axis labels (other chart settings at their defaults, recorded), set FormCollectionGrid Behavior > Hidden = True, perform exactly one Designer Save and verify after one Designer close/reopen. Designer gate (read-only): the Designer is in User scope and FX_OrdersChart is open and clean (Save and Undo disabled; open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry if needed); Behavior > Initial Command reads Refresh; the Components grid shows Pane (00), FormCollectionGrid and 10 GridColumns and no Chart. If the Designer is dirty, a Chart already exists, or the session shows the server-event error, record it and stop blocked.

Move the grid: select FormCollectionGrid and set only its Layout > Location Top to (Form Size height - grid Size height - 1), leaving Left and Size unchanged; commit and read back. If the computed Top is below 12 or the grid would leave the Form area, record the values and stop blocked for the coordinator. At most one correction.

Add the chart: click the Chart row in the Toolbox once, then click once on an empty spot of the canvas above the moved grid (a canvas coordinate click, as the toolbox recipe requires). Record the generated name, type and default Size and Location. If the new component is not a Chart, or it landed inside the grid, record it and stop blocked without removing it. Rename it FX_OrderTotalChart (Name property; commit; read back). Set its Layout > Location Top 1 and Left equal to the grid's Left, and Size width equal to the grid's width and height equal to (the new grid Top - 2); commit and read back. At most one correction per field.

Chart binding: with FX_OrderTotalChart selected, record its Data Source group, set Binding Type to Chart (from its drop-down), then open the Binding (...) dialog once. Record every field, list and default before changing anything, with screenshots. Add FX_DerOrderTotal to Chart Data (from the offered property list) and choose FX_OrderNumber as the property for X-axis labels; leave every other setting (chart type, series, axes, colors) at its default and record it. Confirm with OK once and read back the Binding value and every chart-related property shown in Properties. At most one correction per field; if a value still reads back wrong, record both values and stop blocked without Save.
Hide the grid: select FormCollectionGrid and set only Behavior > Hidden = True (from its drop-down); commit and read back. Change no other property.

Perform exactly one Designer Save through the native toolbar Save and record its native response verbatim (toast, dialog or error) with a screenshot. If an error appears, record it and stop blocked; never retry the Save.

Persistence: close the clean FX_OrdersChart Designer Form once through its Form-tab control (take a fresh snapshot immediately before the click and use only its references; record any prompt; if a save prompt appears, answer No once and record its text) and reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry; verify User scope and Save disabled; read back the Components inventory (expected Pane (00), FormCollectionGrid, 10 GridColumns and FX_OrderTotalChart), FX_OrderTotalChart's Binding Type, Binding, Size and Location, FormCollectionGrid's Hidden, Size and Location, and Initial Command (expected Refresh), with screenshots. If Save is enabled after the readback, close once answering No and reopen once to restore clean; if it is still enabled, record it and stop blocked.

Runtime chart check (read-only): in the Web Client open FX_OrdersChart once through the Form menu recent-forms entry if it is listed, otherwise through Form > Open > Select Form (clear a prefilled filter and type FX_OrdersChart, one extra key event allowed to refresh the list, then double-click the exact FX_OrdersChart row). Record any message verbatim. Change no value; do not click into the chart. Close the runtime FX_OrdersChart Form once (clean); if any prompt appears answer No once and record its exact text.

Capture screenshots of the Designer gate with the Layout values, the grid after the move, the Chart placement, the rename and Layout readbacks, the Data Source group, the Binding dialog before and after filling, the Hidden readback, the Save response, the reopened readbacks and the runtime Form. notes: Proposed by the operator assistant after EXP-097; the operator said yes on 2026-10-15. Tenant mapping: tutorial chart field 'dir order total' -> FX_DerOrderTotal; X-axis Order Number -> FX_OrderNumber; the chart component is named FX_OrderTotalChart to keep the FX_ prefix on factory artifacts. The tutorial resizes the grid by dragging; here the grid and chart are positioned through Layout > Size and Location (property entry proven in EXP-062-R4) so the only coordinate click is the Toolbox canvas placement. The transcript gives no chart type, aggregation or styling, so every chart setting except the data and X-axis label stays default and is recorded. Expected runtime values: order 1 90.00, order 2 6.99 (Initial Command Refresh loads them without F4, EXP-097).
